import os
import time


def write_log(content, level="INFO", log_dir="./log"):
    """Write a log entry to a monthly log file.
    
    Args:
        content (str): Log message content.
        level (str): Log level (e.g., 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR').
        log_dir (str): Directory to store log files.
    """
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    date_str = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', time.localtime(time.time()))
    update_log = f"[{date_str}] [{level}] {content}\n"
    print(update_log)
    
    log_filename = f"{log_dir}/{time.strftime('%Y-%m', time.localtime(time.time()))}-update.log"
    with open(log_filename, 'a', encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(update_log)
